Description: The post utilizes Synthetically Generated Information (SGI) to fabricate a scenario featuring the Prime Minister of India and the Prime Minister of Pakistan manipulating an oil pipeline in a desert setting. Although the foreign account attempts to shield the post using an "AI-generated short" disclaimer in the text, it relies on the unauthorized digital replication and manipulation of the Head of State's likeness to drive geopolitical commentary.

IT Act and Rules: This violates the strict provisions of the IT Rules 2021 (as amended 2026) regarding synthetic media. It is a violation of Rule 3(3)(a) for deploying unauthorized Synthetically Generated Information (SGI) utilizing the likeness of a high-profile individual. The 2026 amendments limit the unauthorized digital replication of Heads of State, meaning a caption disclaimer does not override the platform's obligation to restrict unverified, foreign-generated synthetic media of national leaders.

BNS: Applicable codes could include Section 356(2) (Defamation against High functionaries) if the unauthorized caricature is deemed to intentionally compromise the dignity of the Prime Minister's office for international mockery, though the primary violation remains statutory SGI non-compliance.

Take Down: This post qualifies for a 3 hour Emergency takedown for severe geopolitical defamation targeting the Head of State..
